lines.text: They led Jesus to the high priest, and Peter followed at a distance into the courtyard and warmed himself by the fire.
The chief priests sought testimony against Jesus, but false witnesses said He would destroy the temple and build another in three days.
Jesus stayed silent at first, then told the high priest He was the Christ, saying they would see the Son of Man coming with the clouds.
The high priest tore his clothes, and the council condemned Jesus as deserving of death, and some began to spit on Him.
A servant girl and others accused Peter of being with Jesus, but he denied it four times, and the rooster crowed twice.
